sections.contenu:
*Subject: Faulty headset – order no. 7834*

*Dear Sir or Madam,*

*I am writing to **complain about** the headset I ordered on 2 March. Although it was delivered on time, the microphone **does not work**. I have followed the instructions in the manual, but the problem **persists**. I would therefore like a **replacement** or a **full refund**. I look forward to your prompt reply.*

*Yours faithfully,*

Réponse du service client : *We **apologise for** the inconvenience. We will send you a replacement free of charge and, **as a goodwill gesture**, offer you a 10% discount on your next order.*
notions: Service client et réclamation : mise en situation

sections.contenu:
| Anglais | Français | Exemple |
|---|---|---|
| **to complain (about)** | se plaindre (de), faire une réclamation | *Several customers complained about the delay.* |
| **to refund** | rembourser | *We will refund the full amount.* |
| **to replace** | remplacer | *Can you replace the damaged item?* |
| **to apologise (for)** | s'excuser (de) | *We apologise for any inconvenience.* |
| **to fix** | réparer, régler | *The technician fixed the problem in an hour.* |
| **to compensate** | dédommager | *The airline compensated the passengers.* |
| **to escalate** | transmettre à un niveau supérieur | *I'll escalate your request to my manager.* |

| Anglais | Français | Exemple |
|---|---|---|
| **a complaint** | une réclamation | *We received your complaint yesterday.* |
| **a refund** | un remboursement | *I'd like a full refund.* |
| **a warranty** | une garantie | *The laptop is still under warranty.* |
| **a receipt** | un reçu, un ticket de caisse | *Please keep your receipt.* |
| **a defect** | un défaut | *There is a defect in the screen.* |
| **a discount** | une remise, une réduction | *We can offer you a 15% discount.* |
| **customer service** | le service client | *Customer service is available 24/7.* |

| Anglais | Français | Exemple |
|---|---|---|
| **faulty / defective** | défectueux | *The charger is faulty.* |
| **damaged** | endommagé | *The parcel arrived damaged.* |
| **unacceptable** | inacceptable | *This delay is unacceptable.* |
| **prompt** | rapide | *Thank you for your prompt reply.* |
| **free of charge** | gratuitement | *Repairs are free of charge.* |
| **unfortunately** | malheureusement | *Unfortunately, the item is out of stock.* |
